model.expr: (sum by(provider) (rate({service=~"tokens-.+"} | json | event="external_call" | provider!~"birdeye|coingecko|jupiter|logo_.*" | ok="false" [5m])) / sum by(provider) (rate({service=~"tokens-.+"} | json | event="external_call" | provider!~"birdeye|coingecko|jupiter|logo_.*" [5m]))) and (sum by(provider) (rate({service=~"tokens-.+"} | json | event="external_call" | provider!~"birdeye|coingecko|jupiter|logo_.*" [5m])) > 0.05)

annotations.description: Provider {{ $labels.provider }} returned errors on >30% of calls for 30m (min 0.05 calls/sec floor). This rule catches everything outside the critical tier (birdeye/coingecko/jupiter) and outside the logo-sync probes (provider=logo_*, which fetch arbitrary third-party artwork URLs where 404s, redirects and blocked gateways are expected outcomes — see tokens-assets-logo-sync-failing for that job's health), so user-facing impact depends on which provider fired — open the External providers dashboard and the runbook before assuming low urgency. No page; Slack only.
